what: Plan-context renderer removes plan/repo verification permission
scenario_or_breakage: Design voters may only be told to read the ballot, so they can accept or reject plan-modification claims without checking the plan or referenced repo files
suggested_fix: Preserve the current plan-context wording for --verification-context plan, or add an explicit --plan-file and test that plan voters may inspect plan/repo evidence silently

what: Drift guard ignores two of the four canonical OOS copies
scenario_or_breakage: The helper and voting-protocol copy can stay updated while the design/implement MAV prose keeps stale OOS decision rules for 0-judge fallback
suggested_fix: Have the drift guard grep the exact canonical clause in skills/shared/voting-protocol.md, skills/design/SKILL.md, and skills/implement/SKILL.md, or generate/import one snippet instead of maintaining four literals

what: Stdout contract is underspecified under lib-quiet
scenario_or_breakage: If the new helper follows the common source-plus-larch_quiet_init pattern while called from quieted dispatchers, the prompt body can be redirected to the quiet log and the > prompt_file target becomes empty
suggested_fix: Explicitly disable quiet for this renderer or restore stdout with exec 1>&3/use emit, and add a harness case with inherited LARCH_QUIET_ACTIVE/LARCH_QUIET_PID

what: HTML drift marker would sit inside the fenced prompt template
scenario_or_breakage: The marker renders as literal prompt text in the documented template and may be copied into voter prompts
suggested_fix: Move the marker outside the fenced template or make it surrounding prose, keeping the prompt block free of non-prompt comments
